newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco sees Chuquicamata 96 output above target.
newsitem.headline: Codelco sees Chuquicamata 96 output above target.

text.p: Chile's state copper company Codelco expects its huge Chuquicamata mine to produce over 630,000 tonnes of copper this year, compared with its target of 618,000 tonnes, said a division spokesman.
"The division will produce more than 630,000 tonnes in 1996," the spokesman told Reuters by telephone from the pit.
The improvement is the result of greater efficiency at the mine, the largest of Codelco's four divisions, he said.
Chuquicamata made up for production lost during a 10-day strike in May by working on public holidays in September when the pit is usually closed.
The mine produced 610,150 tonnes of fine copper last year.
